elements.name: drone
elements.description: Drones are the lowest class of worker in your swarm. They continuously gather meat to feed your swarm.
elements.lol: Not to be confused with probes or mules.
elements.label: drone

elements.name: queen
elements.description: Queens rule over your swarm's workers.
elements.lol: I want to ride my bicycle / I want to ride my bike / I want to ride my bicycle / I want to ride it where I like
elements.label: queen

elements.name: nest
elements.description: Nests provide space and support for your swarm's queens.
elements.lol: They also have fancy temperature controls.
elements.label: nest
elements.warnfirst.text: Your first nest will take a long time to regenerate the queens sacrificed to build it. Consider hatching more queens first.

elements.name: greaterqueen
elements.description: Greater queens rule over the lesser queens of very large swarms.
elements.lol: Can't think of a name? Pick another creature and slap "greater" in front of it!
elements.label: greater queen
elements.warnfirst.text: Your first few greater queens will take a long time to regenerate the nests sacrificed to build them. Consider building more nests first.

elements.name: hive
elements.description: Hives are huge structures crafted from meat and the bodies of thousands of queens. They allow your swarm to grow even faster.
elements.lol: Serve the hive. Feel the groove. I control the way you move.
elements.label: hive
elements.warnfirst.text: Your first few hives will take a long time to regenerate the greater queens sacrificed to build them. Consider hatching more greater queens first.

elements.name: hivequeen
elements.description: Hive queens oversee the production of hives in the largest swarms.
elements.lol: Managers managing managers managing managers.
elements.label: hive queen
elements.warnfirst.text: Your first few hive queens will take a long time to regenerate the hives sacrificed to build them. Consider building more hives first.

elements.name: empress
elements.description: The mightiest creature to rule over your swarm so far.
elements.lol: On her thorax and on her forewing she has this name written: queen of queens and lady of ladies.
elements.label: hive empress

elements.name: prophet
elements.description: Your prophets foresee the guidance of a higher power, a greater being - yet, the heavens have fallen silent.
elements.lol: Heavens and goddesses and pantheons never really made much sense for a swarm, did they?
elements.label: neuroprophet

elements.name: goddess
elements.description: Neurons are the building blocks of a greater hive intelligence.
elements.lol: Thanks, Neuronerd. Miss you.
elements.label: hive neuron

elements.name: pantheon
elements.description: Groups of neurons begin to exert mild psychic powers, influencing the minds of lesser creatures in your swarm.
elements.lol: Their trick for avoiding cluster headaches is to avoid having a head.
elements.label: neural cluster

elements.name: pantheon2
elements.description: Networking your hive's neurons allows them to coordinate their actions, much as a single entity would.
elements.lol: Networks also allow them to play games and watch videos of ...uh, cats.
elements.label: hive network

elements.name: pantheon3
elements.description: Your neural networks have finally formed a single greater intelligence, primitive though it may be. The psychic powers of lesser hive minds are great enough to directly control several hundred lesser members of your swarm.
elements.lol: Hey, "lesser" works just as well as "greater" for naming things!
elements.label: lesser hive mind

elements.name: pantheon4
elements.description: Mature hive minds control thousands of lesser members of your swarm, and their capacity for intelligent planning is dramatically improved.
elements.lol: Do hive minds have hives on their minds? Sounds painful.
elements.label: hive mind

elements.name: pantheon5
elements.description: Multiple hive minds merge their collective consciousness into a single greater being.
elements.lol: By your powers combined...
elements.label: arch-mind

elements.name: overmind
elements.description: The Overmind psychically controls the actions of every member of your swarm, including all of the lesser hive minds. Building more physical manifestations of the Overmind merely increases its influence; all belong to the same being, the same greater intelligence. Your swarm now exists to serve the will of its Overmind.
elements.lol: SO much cooler than that infested human, even if she did win.
elements.label: overmind

elements.description: Weak flying warriors. They roam in packs, attacking any threats with venomous stingers.
elements.lol: Reasonably smart critters - they consistently earn a 3.0 GPA.
